file.content:
From stdpp Require Export gmap.

Require Export cgraphs.multiparty.langdef.

Inductive object := Thread (_:nat) | Chan (_:session).

Definition object_code (x : object) : (nat + nat)%type :=
  match x with Thread n => inl n | Chan n => inr n end.

Definition object_decode (c : (nat + nat)%type) : object :=
  match c with inl n => Thread n | inr n => Chan n end.

Definition object_roundtrip (x : object) : object_decode (object_code x) = x :=
  match x with Thread _ => eq_refl | Chan _ => eq_refl end.

#[export] Instance object_eqdecision : EqDecision object :=
  fun x y =>
    match decide (object_code x = object_code y) with
    | left h =>
        left (eq_trans (eq_sym (object_roundtrip x))
          (eq_trans (f_equal object_decode h) (object_roundtrip y)))
    | right h => right (fun p => h (f_equal object_code p))
    end.

#[export] Instance object_countable : Countable object :=
  inj_countable' object_code object_decode object_roundtrip.

Fixpoint expr_refs (e : expr) : gset object :=
  match e with
  | Val v => val_refs v
  | Var x => ∅
  | Pair e1 e2 => expr_refs e1 ∪ expr_refs e2
  | Inj b e1 => expr_refs e1
  | App e1 e2 => expr_refs e1 ∪ expr_refs e2
  | UApp e1 e2 => expr_refs e1 ∪ expr_refs e2
  | Lam s e1 => expr_refs e1
  | ULam s e1 => expr_refs e1
  | Send p e1 i e2 => expr_refs e1 ∪ expr_refs e2
  | Recv p e1 => expr_refs e1
  | Let s e1 e2 => expr_refs e1 ∪ expr_refs e2
  | LetUnit e1 e2 => expr_refs e1 ∪ expr_refs e2
  | LetProd s1 s2 e1 e2 => expr_refs e1 ∪ expr_refs e2
  | MatchVoid e1 => expr_refs e1
  | MatchSum e1 s e2 e3 => expr_refs e1 ∪ expr_refs e2 ∪ expr_refs e3
  | InjN i e => expr_refs e
  | MatchSumN n e f => expr_refs e ∪ fin_union n (expr_refs ∘ f)
  | If e1 e2 e3 => expr_refs e1 ∪ expr_refs e2
  | Spawn n f => fin_union n (expr_refs ∘ f)
  | Close e1 => expr_refs e1
  | Relabel π e1 => expr_refs e1
  end
with val_refs (v : val) : gset object :=
  match v with
  | UnitV => ∅
  | NatV n => ∅
  | PairV v1 v2 => val_refs v1 ∪ val_refs v2
  | InjV b v1 => val_refs v1
  | InjNV i v1 => val_refs v1
  | FunV s e1 => expr_refs e1
  | UFunV s e1 => expr_refs e1
  | ChanV (c,b) _ => {[ Chan c ]}
  end.

Definition map_union `{Countable K, Countable A} {V} (f : V -> gset A) (m : gmap K V) :=
  map_fold (λ k v s, f v ∪ s) ∅ m.

Definition buf_refs (buf : list entryT) := foldr (λ '(i,v) s, val_refs v ∪ s) ∅ buf.

Definition bufs_refs (bufss : bufsT participant participant entryT) : gset object :=
  map_union (map_union buf_refs) bufss.

Definition obj_refs (es : list expr) (h : heap) (x : object) : gset object :=
  match x with
  | Thread n => from_option expr_refs ∅ (es !! n)
  | Chan c => bufs_refs (gmap_slice h c)
  end.

Definition thread_blocked (es : list expr) (h : heap) (i c : nat) :=
  ∃ p q k π, ctx k ∧
    es !! i = Some (k (Recv p (Val (ChanV (c,q) π)))) ∧
    is_Some (h !! (c,q)) ∧
    pop (π p) (c,q) h = None.

Definition active (es : list expr) (h : heap) (x : object) :=
  match x with
  | Thread i => ∃ e, es !! i = Some e ∧ e ≠ Val UnitV
  | Chan i => ∃ p, is_Some (h !! (i,p))
  end.

Record deadlock (es : list expr) (h : heap) (s : gset object) := {
  dl_nonempty : s ≠ ∅;
  dl_active x : x ∈ s -> active es h x;
  dl_threadb i : Thread i ∈ s -> ¬ can_stepi i es h;
  dl_threadw i c : Thread i ∈ s -> thread_blocked es h i c -> Chan c ∈ s;
  dl_chan c x : Chan c ∈ s -> Chan c ∈ obj_refs es h x -> x ∈ s
}.

Definition deadlock_free es h := ∀ s, ¬ deadlock es h s.

Inductive reachable (es : list expr) (h : heap) : object → Prop :=
  | Thread_step_reachable i : can_stepi i es h → reachable es h (Thread i)
  | Thread_blocked_reachable i c : reachable es h (Chan c) → thread_blocked es h i c → reachable es h (Thread i)
  | Chan_ref_reachable c x : (Chan c) ∈ obj_refs es h x → reachable es h x → reachable es h (Chan c).

Definition fully_reachable es h := ∀ x, active es h x -> reachable es h x.

1	From Stdlib Require Import Strings.String.
2	From stdpp Require Import gmap.
3	
4	From cgraphs.multiparty Require Export mutil.
5	
6	From cgraphs.cgraphs Require Export util.
7	
8	Definition session := nat.
9	
10	Definition participant := nat.
11	
12	Definition endpoint := (session * participant)%type.
13	
14	Inductive val :=
15	  | UnitV : val
16	  | NatV : nat -> val
17	  | PairV : val -> val -> val
18	  | InjV : bool -> val -> val
19	  | InjNV : nat -> val -> val
20	  | FunV : string -> expr -> val
21	  | UFunV : string -> expr -> val
22	  | ChanV : endpoint -> (participant -> participant) -> val
23	
24	with expr :=
25	  | Val : val -> expr
26	  | Var : string -> expr
27	  | Pair : expr -> expr -> expr
28	  | Inj : bool -> expr -> expr
29	  | InjN : nat -> expr -> expr
30	  | App : expr -> expr -> expr
31	  | UApp : expr -> expr -> expr
32	  | Lam : string -> expr -> expr
33	  | ULam : string -> expr -> expr
34	  | Send : participant -> expr -> nat -> expr -> expr
35	  | Recv : participant -> expr -> expr
36	  | Let : string -> expr -> expr -> expr
37	  | LetUnit : expr -> expr -> expr
38	  | LetProd : string -> string -> expr -> expr -> expr
39	  | MatchVoid : expr -> expr
40	  | MatchSum : expr -> string -> expr -> expr -> expr
41	  | MatchSumN n : expr -> (fin n -> expr) -> expr
42	  | If : expr -> expr -> expr -> expr
43	  | Spawn n : (fin n -> expr) -> expr
44	  | Close : expr -> expr
45	  | Relabel : (participant -> participant) -> expr -> expr.
46	
47	Fixpoint subst (x:string) (a:val) (e:expr) : expr :=
48	  match e with
49	  | Val _ => e
50	  | Var x' => if decide (x = x') then Val a else e
51	  | App e1 e2 => App (subst x a e1) (subst x a e2)
52	  | Inj b e1 => Inj b (subst x a e1)
53	  | Pair e1 e2 => Pair (subst x a e1) (subst x a e2)
54	  | UApp e1 e2 => UApp (subst x a e1) (subst x a e2)
55	  | Lam x' e1 => if decide (x = x') then e else Lam x' (subst x a e1)
56	  | ULam x' e1 => if decide (x = x') then e else ULam x' (subst x a e1)
57	  | Send p e1 i e2 => Send p (subst x a e1) i (subst x a e2)
58	  | Recv p e1 => Recv p (subst x a e1)
59	  | Let x' e1 e2 => Let x' (subst x a e1) (if decide (x = x') then e2 else subst x a e2)
60	  | LetUnit e1 e2 => LetUnit (subst x a e1) (subst x a e2)
61	  | LetProd x' y' e1 e2 =>
62	    LetProd x' y' (subst x a e1) (if decide (x = x' ∨ x = y') then e2 else subst x a e2)
63	  | MatchVoid e1 => MatchVoid (subst x a e1)
64	  | MatchSum e1 x' eL eR =>
65	    MatchSum (subst x a e1) x'
66	    (if decide (x = x') then eL else subst x a eL)
67	    (if decide (x = x') then eR else subst x a eR)
68	  | InjN n e => InjN n (subst x a e)
69	  | MatchSumN n e f => MatchSumN n (subst x a e) (λ i, subst x a (f i))
70	  | If e1 e2 e3 => If (subst x a e1) (subst x a e2) (subst x a e3)
71	  | Spawn ps f => Spawn ps (λ p, subst x a (f p))
72	  | Close e1 => Close (subst x a e1)
73	  | Relabel π e1 => Relabel π (subst x a e1)
74	  end.
75	
76	Inductive pure_step : expr -> expr -> Prop :=
77	  | Pair_step : ∀ v1 v2,
78	    pure_step (Pair (Val v1) (Val v2)) (Val (PairV v1 v2))
79	  | Inj_step : ∀ v1 b,
80	    pure_step (Inj b (Val v1)) (Val (InjV b v1))
81	  | App_step : ∀ x e a,
82	    pure_step (App (Val (FunV x e)) (Val a)) (subst x a e)
83	  | UApp_step : ∀ x e a,
84	    pure_step (UApp (Val (UFunV x e)) (Val a)) (subst x a e)
85	  | Lam_step : ∀ x e,
86	    pure_step (Lam x e) (Val (FunV x e))
87	  | ULam_step : ∀ x e,
88	    pure_step (ULam x e) (Val (UFunV x e))
89	  | If_step1 : ∀ n e1 e2,
90	    n ≠ 0 ->
91	    pure_step (If (Val (NatV n)) e1 e2) e1
92	  | If_step2 : ∀ e1 e2,
93	    pure_step (If (Val (NatV 0)) e1 e2) e2
94	  | MatchSum_step : ∀ x v eL eR b,
95	    pure_step (MatchSum (Val (InjV b v)) x eL eR)
96	      (if b then subst x v eL else subst x v eR)
97	  | InjN_step : ∀ n v,
98	    pure_step (InjN n (Val v)) (Val (InjNV n v))
99	  | MatchSumN_step : ∀ n i v f,
100	    pure_step (MatchSumN n (Val (InjNV (fin_to_nat i) v)) f) (App (f i) (Val v))
101	  | Let_step : ∀ x v e,
102	    pure_step (Let x (Val v) e) (subst x v e)
103	  | LetUnit_step : ∀ e,
104	    pure_step (LetUnit (Val UnitV) e) e
105	  | LetProd_step : ∀ x1 x2 v1 v2 e,
106	    pure_step (LetProd x1 x2 (Val (PairV v1 v2)) e) (subst x1 v1 $ subst x2 v2 e)
107	  | Relabel_step : ∀ π1 π2 c p,
108	    pure_step (Relabel π1 (Val (ChanV (c,p) π2))) (Val (ChanV (c,p) (π2 ∘ π1))).

110	Definition entryT := (nat * val)%type.
111	
112	Notation bufsT A B V := (gmap B (gmap A (list V))).
113	
114	Definition heap := bufsT participant endpoint entryT.
115	
116	Definition push `{Countable A, Countable B} {V} (p : A) (q : B) (x : V) (bufss : bufsT A B V) : bufsT A B V :=
117	  alter (alter (λ buf, buf ++ [x]) p) q bufss.
118	
119	Definition pop `{Countable A, Countable B} {V} (p : A) (q : B) (bufss : bufsT A B V) : option (V * bufsT A B V) :=
120	  match bufss !! q with
121	  | Some bufs =>
122	    match bufs !! p with
123	    | Some (v :: buf) => Some (v, <[ q := <[ p := buf ]> bufs ]> bufss)
124	    | _ => None
125	    end
126	  | None => None
127	  end.
128	
129	Definition init_chans {A} n : bufsT participant participant A :=
130	  fin_gmap n (λ i, fin_gmap n (λ j, [])).
131	
132	Definition init_threads (c : session) (n : nat) (fv : fin n -> val) : list expr :=
133	  fin_list n (λ i, App (Val (fv i)) (Val (ChanV (c, S (fin_to_nat i)) id))).
134	
135	Inductive head_step : expr -> heap -> expr -> heap -> list expr -> Prop :=
136	  | Pure_step : ∀ e e' h,
137	    pure_step e e' -> head_step e h e' h []
138	  | Send_step : ∀ h c p q y i π,
139	
140	
141	    head_step (Send q (Val (ChanV (c,p) π)) i (Val y)) h
142	          (Val (ChanV (c,p) π))
143	          (push p (c,π q) (i,y) h)
144	          []
145	  | Recv_step : ∀ h c p q i y h' π,
146	    pop (π p) (c,q) h = Some ((i,y), h') ->
147	    head_step (Recv p (Val (ChanV (c,q) π))) h
148	          (Val (InjNV i (PairV (ChanV (c,q) π) y)))
149	          h'
150	          []
151	  | Close_step : ∀ c p h π,
152	    head_step (Close (Val (ChanV (c,p) π))) h
153	          (Val UnitV)
154	          (delete (c,p) h)
155	          []
156	  | Spawn_step : ∀ (h : heap) c n f fv,
157	    (∀ p, h !! (c,p) = None) ->
158	    (∀ p, f p = Val (fv p)) ->
159	    head_step
160	      (Spawn n f) h
161	      (Val (ChanV (c, 0) id))
162	      (gmap_unslice (init_chans (S n)) c ∪ h)
163	      (init_threads c n fv).
164	
165	Inductive ctx1 : (expr -> expr) -> Prop :=
166	  | Ctx_App_l e : ctx1 (λ x, App x e)
167	  | Ctx_App_r v : ctx1 (λ x, App (Val v) x)
168	  | Ctx_Pair_l e : ctx1 (λ x, Pair x e)
169	  | Ctx_Pair_r v : ctx1 (λ x, Pair (Val v) x)
170	  | Ctx_Inj b : ctx1 (λ x, Inj b x)
171	  | Ctx_UApp_l e : ctx1 (λ x, UApp x e)
172	  | Ctx_UApp_r v : ctx1 (λ x, UApp (Val v) x)
173	  | Ctx_Send_l p e i : ctx1 (λ x, Send p x i e)
174	  | Ctx_Send_r p v i : ctx1 (λ x, Send p (Val v) i x)
175	  | Ctx_Recv p : ctx1 (λ x, Recv p x)
176	  | Ctx_Let s e : ctx1 (λ x, Let s x e)
177	  | Ctx_LetUnit e : ctx1 (λ x, LetUnit x e)
178	  | Ctx_LetProd s1 s2 e : ctx1 (λ x, LetProd s1 s2 x e)
179	  | Ctx_MatchVoid : ctx1 (λ x, MatchVoid x)
180	  | Ctx_MatchSum s e1 e2 : ctx1 (λ x, MatchSum x s e1 e2)
181	  | Ctx_InjN i : ctx1 (λ x, InjN i x)
182	  | Ctx_MatchSumN n f : ctx1 (λ x, MatchSumN n x f)
183	  | Ctx_If e1 e2 : ctx1 (λ x, If x e1 e2)
184	  | Ctx_Spawn n (f : fin n -> expr) (p : fin n) :
185	    ctx1 (λ x, Spawn n (λ q, if decide (p = q) then x else f q))
186	  | Ctx_Close : ctx1 (λ x, Close x)
187	  | Ctx_Relabel π : ctx1 (λ x, Relabel π x).
188	
189	Inductive ctx : (expr -> expr) -> Prop :=
190	  | Ctx_nil : ctx (λ x, x)
191	  | Ctx_cons : ∀ k1 k2, ctx1 k1 -> ctx k2 -> ctx (λ x, (k1 (k2 x))).
192	
193	Inductive ctx_step : expr -> heap -> expr -> heap -> list expr -> Prop :=
194	  | Ctx_step : ∀ k e h e' h' ts,
195	    ctx k -> head_step e h e' h' ts -> ctx_step (k e) h (k e') h' ts.
196	
197	Inductive stepi : nat -> list expr -> heap -> list expr -> heap -> Prop :=
198	  | Head_step : ∀ e e' h h' i ts es,
199	    ctx_step e h e' h' ts ->
200	    es !! i = Some e ->
201	    stepi i es h (<[i := e']> es ++ ts) h'.
202	
203	Definition can_stepi i es h := ∃ es' h', stepi i es h es' h'.
204	
205	Definition step es h es' h' := ∃ i, stepi i es h es' h'.
206	
207	Inductive steps : list expr -> heap -> list expr -> heap -> Prop :=
208	  | Trans_step : ∀ e1 e2 e3 s1 s2 s3,
209	    step e1 s1 e2 s2 ->
210	    steps e2 s2 e3 s3 ->
211	    steps e1 s1 e3 s3
212	  | Empty_step : ∀ e1 s1,
213	    steps e1 s1 e1 s1.
214	
215	CoInductive session_type' (T : Type) :=
216	  | SendT n : participant -> (fin n -> T) -> (fin n -> session_type' T) -> session_type' T
217	  | RecvT n : participant -> (fin n -> T) -> (fin n -> session_type' T) -> session_type' T
218	  | EndT : session_type' T.
219	
220	Arguments SendT {_} _ _ _.
221	
222	Arguments RecvT {_} _ _ _.
223	
224	Arguments EndT {_}.
225	
226	Global Instance finvec_equiv `{Equiv T} n : Equiv (fin n -> T) := λ f g, ∀ i, f i ≡ g i.
227	
228	CoInductive session_type_equiv `{Equiv T} : Equiv (session_type' T) :=
229	  | cteq_EndT : EndT ≡ EndT
230	  | cteq_SendT n t1 t2 f1 f2 p : t1 ≡ t2 -> f1 ≡ f2 -> SendT n p t1 f1 ≡ SendT n p t2 f2
231	  | cteq_RecvT n t1 t2 f1 f2 p : t1 ≡ t2 -> f1 ≡ f2 -> RecvT n p t1 f1 ≡ RecvT n p t2 f2.
232	
233	Global Existing Instance session_type_equiv.
234	
235	Definition session_type_id {T} (s : session_type' T) : session_type' T :=
236	  match s with
237	  | SendT n p t s' => SendT n p t s'
238	  | RecvT n p t s' => RecvT n p t s'
239	  | EndT => EndT
240	  end.
241	
242	CoInductive type :=
243	  | UnitT : type
244	  | VoidT : type
245	  | NatT : type
246	  | PairT : type -> type -> type
247	  | SumT : type -> type -> type
248	  | SumNT n : (fin n -> type) -> type
249	  | FunT : type -> type -> type
250	  | UFunT : type -> type -> type
251	  | ChanT : session_type' type -> type.
252	
253	Definition type_id (t : type) :=
254	  match t with
255	  | UnitT => UnitT
256	  | VoidT => VoidT
257	  | NatT => NatT
258	  | PairT t1 t2 => PairT t1 t2
259	  | SumT t1 t2 => SumT t1 t2
260	  | SumNT n f => SumNT n f
261	  | FunT t1 t2 => FunT t1 t2
262	  | UFunT t1 t2 => UFunT t1 t2
263	  | ChanT s => ChanT s
264	  end.
265	
266	CoInductive type_equiv : Equiv type :=
267	  | teq_UnitT : UnitT ≡ UnitT
268	  | teq_VoidT : VoidT ≡ VoidT
269	  | teq_NatT : NatT ≡ NatT
270	  | teq_PairT t1 t2 t1' t2' : t1 ≡ t2 -> t1' ≡ t2' -> PairT t1 t1' ≡ PairT t2 t2'
271	  | teq_SumT t1 t2 t1' t2' : t1 ≡ t2 -> t1' ≡ t2' -> SumT t1 t1' ≡ SumT t2 t2'
272	  | teq_SumNT n f1 f2 : f1 ≡ f2 -> SumNT n f1 ≡ SumNT n f2
273	  | teq_FunT t1 t2 t1' t2' : t1 ≡ t2 -> t1' ≡ t2' -> FunT t1 t1' ≡ FunT t2 t2'
274	  | teq_UFunT t1 t2 t1' t2' : t1 ≡ t2 -> t1' ≡ t2' -> UFunT t1 t1' ≡ UFunT t2 t2'
275	  | teq_ChanT s1 s2 : s1 ≡ s2 -> ChanT s1 ≡ ChanT s2.
276	
277	Global Existing Instance type_equiv.
278	
279	Notation session_type := (session_type' type).
280	
281	CoFixpoint relabelT (π : participant -> participant) (σ : session_type) :=
282	  match σ with
283	  | SendT n p ts σs => SendT n (π p) ts (relabelT π ∘ σs)
284	  | RecvT n p ts σs => RecvT n (π p) ts (relabelT π ∘ σs)
285	  | EndT => EndT
286	  end.
287	
288	Notation envT := (gmap string type).
289	
290	CoInductive unrestricted : type -> Prop :=
291	  | Nat_unrestricted : unrestricted NatT
292	  | Unit_unrestricted : unrestricted UnitT
293	  | Void_unrestricted : unrestricted VoidT
294	  | UFun_unrestricted t1 t2 : unrestricted (UFunT t1 t2)
295	  | Pair_unrestricted t1 t2 :
296	    unrestricted t1 -> unrestricted t2 ->
297	    unrestricted (PairT t1 t2)
298	  | Sum_unrestricted t1 t2 :
299	    unrestricted t1 -> unrestricted t2 ->
300	    unrestricted (SumT t1 t2)
301	  | SumN_unrestricted n f :
302	    (∀ i, unrestricted (f i)) -> unrestricted (SumNT n f).
303	
304	Definition disj (Γ1 Γ2 : envT) : Prop :=
305	  ∀ i t1 t2, Γ1 !! i = Some t1 -> Γ2 !! i = Some t2 -> t1 ≡ t2 ∧ unrestricted t1.
306	
307	Definition Γunrestricted (Γ : envT) :=
308	  ∀ x t, Γ !! x = Some t -> unrestricted t.
309	
310	Record disj_union n (Γ : envT) (fΓ : fin n -> envT) : Prop := {
311	  du_disj p q : p ≠ q -> disj (fΓ p) (fΓ q);
312	  du_left p x t : (fΓ p) !! x ≡ Some t -> Γ !! x ≡ Some t;
313	  du_right x t : Γ !! x ≡ Some t -> ∃ p, (fΓ p) !! x ≡ Some t
314	}.
315	
316	Definition sentryT := (nat * type)%type.
317	
318	Definition sbufsT := bufsT participant participant sentryT.
319	
320	Definition can_progress {A}
321	  (bufs : bufsT participant participant A)
322	  (σs : gmap participant session_type) := ∃ q σ,
323	    σs !! q = Some σ ∧
324	    match σ with
325	    | RecvT n p _ _ => ∃ y bufs', pop p q bufs = Some(y,bufs')
326	    | _ => True
327	    end.
328	
329	Definition buf_empty (bufs : bufsT participant participant sentryT) (p : participant) :=
330	  ∀ bs, bufs !! p = Some bs ->
331	    ∀ q buf, bs !! q = Some buf -> buf = [].
332	
333	Definition bufs_empty {A} (bufs : bufsT participant participant A) :=
334	  ∀ p q, pop p q bufs = None.
335	
336	Definition is_present `{Countable A, Countable B} {V}
337	    p q (bufss : bufsT A B V) :=
338	  match bufss !! q with
339	  | Some bufs => match bufs !! p with Some _ => True | None => False end
340	  | None => False
341	  end.
342	
343	CoInductive sbufs_typed
344	  (bufs : bufsT participant participant sentryT)
345	  (σs : gmap participant session_type) : Prop := {
346	
347	
348	
349	
350	  sbufs_typed_send
351	      (n : nat) (p q : participant) ts ss (i : fin n) :
352	    σs !! p = Some (SendT n q ts ss) ->
353	      is_present p q bufs ∧
354	      sbufs_typed (push p q (fin_to_nat i,ts i) bufs) (<[p:=ss i]> σs);
355	
356	
357	
358	
359	  sbufs_typed_recv
360	      (bufs' : bufsT participant participant sentryT)
361	      (n : nat) (p q : participant) t i ts ss :
362	    σs !! q = Some (RecvT n p ts ss) ->
363	    pop p q bufs = Some((i,t),bufs') ->
364	    ∃ i', i = fin_to_nat i' ∧ t = ts i' ∧
365	      sbufs_typed bufs' (<[ q := ss i' ]> σs);
366	
367	
368	
369	
370	  sbufs_typed_end p :
371	    σs !! p = Some EndT ->
372	      buf_empty bufs p ∧
373	      sbufs_typed (delete p bufs) (delete p σs);
374	
375	
376	  sbufs_typed_progress :
377	    bufs = ∅ ∨ can_progress bufs σs;
378	
379	
380	  sbufs_typed_dom :
381	    dom bufs = dom σs
382	}.
383	
384	Definition consistent n (σs : fin n -> session_type) :=
385	  sbufs_typed (init_chans n) (fin_gmap n σs).
386	
387	Inductive typed : envT -> expr -> type -> Prop :=
388	  | Unit_typed Γ :
389	    Γunrestricted Γ ->
390	    typed Γ (Val UnitV) UnitT
391	  | Nat_typed : ∀ Γ n,
392	    Γunrestricted Γ ->
393	    typed Γ (Val (NatV n)) NatT
394	  | Var_typed : ∀ Γ x t t',
395	    Γ !! x = None ->
396	    Γunrestricted Γ ->
397	    t ≡ t' ->
398	    typed (Γ ∪ {[ x := t ]}) (Var x) t'
399	  | Pair_typed : ∀ Γ1 Γ2 e1 e2 t1 t2,
400	    disj Γ1 Γ2 ->
401	    typed Γ1 e1 t1 ->
402	    typed Γ2 e2 t2 ->
403	    typed (Γ1 ∪ Γ2) (Pair e1 e2) (PairT t1 t2)
404	  | App_typed : ∀ Γ1 Γ2 e1 e2 t1 t2,
405	    disj Γ1 Γ2 ->
406	    typed Γ1 e1 (FunT t1 t2) ->
407	    typed Γ2 e2 t1 ->
408	    typed (Γ1 ∪ Γ2) (App e1 e2) t2
409	  | UApp_typed : ∀ Γ1 Γ2 e1 e2 t1 t2,
410	    disj Γ1 Γ2 ->
411	    typed Γ1 e1 (UFunT t1 t2) ->
412	    typed Γ2 e2 t1 ->
413	    typed (Γ1 ∪ Γ2) (UApp e1 e2) t2
414	  | Lam_typed : ∀ Γ x e t1 t2,
415	    Γ !! x = None ->
416	    typed (Γ ∪ {[ x := t1 ]}) e t2 ->
417	    typed Γ (Lam x e) (FunT t1 t2)
418	  | ULam_typed : ∀ Γ x e t1 t2,
419	    Γ !! x = None ->
420	    Γunrestricted Γ ->
421	    typed (Γ ∪ {[ x := t1 ]}) e t2 ->
422	    typed Γ (ULam x e) (UFunT t1 t2)
423	  | Send_typed : ∀ Γ1 Γ2 e1 e2 n t r p i,
424	    disj Γ1 Γ2 ->
425	    typed Γ1 e1 (ChanT (SendT n p t r)) ->
426	    typed Γ2 e2 (t i) ->
427	    typed (Γ1 ∪ Γ2) (Send p e1 (fin_to_nat i) e2) (ChanT (r i))
428	  | Recv_typed : ∀ Γ e n t r p,
429	    typed Γ e (ChanT (RecvT n p t r)) ->
430	    typed Γ (Recv p e) (SumNT n (λ i, PairT (ChanT (r i)) (t i)))
431	  | Let_typed : ∀ Γ1 Γ2 e1 e2 t1 t2 x,
432	    disj Γ1 Γ2 ->
433	    Γ2 !! x = None ->
434	    typed Γ1 e1 t1 ->
435	    typed (Γ2 ∪ {[ x := t1 ]}) e2 t2 ->
436	    typed (Γ1 ∪ Γ2) (Let x e1 e2) t2
437	  | LetUnit_typed : ∀ Γ1 Γ2 e1 e2 t,
438	    disj Γ1 Γ2 ->
439	    typed Γ1 e1 UnitT ->
440	    typed Γ2 e2 t ->
441	    typed (Γ1 ∪ Γ2) (LetUnit e1 e2) t
442	  | LetProd_typed : ∀ Γ1 Γ2 e1 e2 t11 t12 t2 x1 x2,
443	    disj Γ1 Γ2 ->
444	    x1 ≠ x2 ->
445	    Γ2 !! x1 = None ->
446	    Γ2 !! x2 = None ->
447	    typed Γ1 e1 (PairT t11 t12) ->
448	    typed (Γ2 ∪ {[ x1 := t11 ]} ∪ {[ x2 := t12 ]}) e2 t2 ->
449	    typed (Γ1 ∪ Γ2) (LetProd x1 x2 e1 e2) t2
450	  | MatchVoid_typed : ∀ Γ e t,
451	    typed Γ e VoidT ->
452	    typed Γ (MatchVoid e) t
453	  | MatchSum_typed : ∀ Γ1 Γ2 e1 eL eR tL tR t x,
454	    disj Γ1 Γ2 ->
455	    Γ2 !! x = None ->
456	    typed Γ1 e1 (SumT tL tR) ->
457	    typed (Γ2 ∪ {[ x := tL ]}) eL t ->
458	    typed (Γ2 ∪ {[ x := tR ]}) eR t ->
459	    typed (Γ1 ∪ Γ2) (MatchSum e1 x eL eR) t
460	  | InjN_typed : ∀ Γ n f i e,
461	    typed Γ e (f i) ->
462	    typed Γ (InjN (fin_to_nat i) e) (SumNT n f)
463	  | MatchSumN_typed : ∀ n Γ1 Γ2 t (f : fin n -> type) fc e,
464	    disj Γ1 Γ2 ->
465	    (n = 0 -> Γ2 = ∅) ->
466	    typed Γ1 e (SumNT n f) ->
467	    (∀ i, typed Γ2 (fc i) (FunT (f i) t)) ->
468	    typed (Γ1 ∪ Γ2) (MatchSumN n e fc) t
469	  | If_typed : ∀ Γ1 Γ2 e1 e2 e3 t,
470	    disj Γ1 Γ2 ->
471	    typed Γ1 e1 NatT ->
472	    typed Γ2 e2 t ->
473	    typed Γ2 e3 t ->
474	    typed (Γ1 ∪ Γ2) (If e1 e2 e3) t
475	  | Spawn_typed : ∀ n Γ (fΓ : fin n -> envT) (f : fin n -> expr) (σs : fin (S n) -> session_type),
476	    consistent (S n) σs ->
477	    disj_union n Γ fΓ ->
478	    (∀ p, typed (fΓ p) (f p) (FunT (ChanT (σs (FS p))) UnitT)) ->
479	    typed Γ (Spawn n f) (ChanT (σs 0%fin))
480	  | Close_typed : ∀ Γ e,
481	    typed Γ e (ChanT EndT) ->
482	    typed Γ (Close e) UnitT
483	  | Relabel_typed : ∀ Γ π e σ,
484	    typed Γ e (ChanT (relabelT π σ)) ->
485	    typed Γ (Relabel π e) (ChanT σ)
486	  | Iso_typed : ∀ Γ t t' e,
487	    t ≡ t' ->
488	    typed Γ e t ->
489	    typed Γ e t'.

From Stdlib Require Import Strings.String.
From stdpp Require Import gmap.

From cgraphs.multiparty Require Export mutil.

From cgraphs.cgraphs Require Export util.

Definition session := nat.

Definition participant := nat.

Definition endpoint := (session * participant)%type.

Inductive val :=
  | UnitV : val
  | NatV : nat -> val
  | PairV : val -> val -> val
  | InjV : bool -> val -> val
  | InjNV : nat -> val -> val
  | FunV : string -> expr -> val
  | UFunV : string -> expr -> val
  | ChanV : endpoint -> (participant -> participant) -> val

with expr :=
  | Val : val -> expr
  | Var : string -> expr
  | Pair : expr -> expr -> expr
  | Inj : bool -> expr -> expr
  | InjN : nat -> expr -> expr
  | App : expr -> expr -> expr
  | UApp : expr -> expr -> expr
  | Lam : string -> expr -> expr
  | ULam : string -> expr -> expr
  | Send : participant -> expr -> nat -> expr -> expr
  | Recv : participant -> expr -> expr
  | Let : string -> expr -> expr -> expr
  | LetUnit : expr -> expr -> expr
  | LetProd : string -> string -> expr -> expr -> expr
  | MatchVoid : expr -> expr
  | MatchSum : expr -> string -> expr -> expr -> expr
  | MatchSumN n : expr -> (fin n -> expr) -> expr
  | If : expr -> expr -> expr -> expr
  | Spawn n : (fin n -> expr) -> expr
  | Close : expr -> expr
  | Relabel : (participant -> participant) -> expr -> expr.

Fixpoint subst (x:string) (a:val) (e:expr) : expr :=
  match e with
  | Val _ => e
  | Var x' => if decide (x = x') then Val a else e
  | App e1 e2 => App (subst x a e1) (subst x a e2)
  | Inj b e1 => Inj b (subst x a e1)
  | Pair e1 e2 => Pair (subst x a e1) (subst x a e2)
  | UApp e1 e2 => UApp (subst x a e1) (subst x a e2)
  | Lam x' e1 => if decide (x = x') then e else Lam x' (subst x a e1)
  | ULam x' e1 => if decide (x = x') then e else ULam x' (subst x a e1)
  | Send p e1 i e2 => Send p (subst x a e1) i (subst x a e2)
  | Recv p e1 => Recv p (subst x a e1)
  | Let x' e1 e2 => Let x' (subst x a e1) (if decide (x = x') then e2 else subst x a e2)
  | LetUnit e1 e2 => LetUnit (subst x a e1) (subst x a e2)
  | LetProd x' y' e1 e2 =>
    LetProd x' y' (subst x a e1) (if decide (x = x' ∨ x = y') then e2 else subst x a e2)
  | MatchVoid e1 => MatchVoid (subst x a e1)
  | MatchSum e1 x' eL eR =>
    MatchSum (subst x a e1) x'
    (if decide (x = x') then eL else subst x a eL)
    (if decide (x = x') then eR else subst x a eR)
  | InjN n e => InjN n (subst x a e)
  | MatchSumN n e f => MatchSumN n (subst x a e) (λ i, subst x a (f i))
  | If e1 e2 e3 => If (subst x a e1) (subst x a e2) (subst x a e3)
  | Spawn ps f => Spawn ps (λ p, subst x a (f p))
  | Close e1 => Close (subst x a e1)
  | Relabel π e1 => Relabel π (subst x a e1)
  end.

Inductive pure_step : expr -> expr -> Prop :=
  | Pair_step : ∀ v1 v2,
    pure_step (Pair (Val v1) (Val v2)) (Val (PairV v1 v2))
  | Inj_step : ∀ v1 b,
    pure_step (Inj b (Val v1)) (Val (InjV b v1))
  | App_step : ∀ x e a,
    pure_step (App (Val (FunV x e)) (Val a)) (subst x a e)
  | UApp_step : ∀ x e a,
    pure_step (UApp (Val (UFunV x e)) (Val a)) (subst x a e)
  | Lam_step : ∀ x e,
    pure_step (Lam x e) (Val (FunV x e))
  | ULam_step : ∀ x e,
    pure_step (ULam x e) (Val (UFunV x e))
  | If_step1 : ∀ n e1 e2,
    n ≠ 0 ->
    pure_step (If (Val (NatV n)) e1 e2) e1
  | If_step2 : ∀ e1 e2,
    pure_step (If (Val (NatV 0)) e1 e2) e2
  | MatchSum_step : ∀ x v eL eR b,
    pure_step (MatchSum (Val (InjV b v)) x eL eR)
      (if b then subst x v eL else subst x v eR)
  | InjN_step : ∀ n v,
    pure_step (InjN n (Val v)) (Val (InjNV n v))
  | MatchSumN_step : ∀ n i v f,
    pure_step (MatchSumN n (Val (InjNV (fin_to_nat i) v)) f) (App (f i) (Val v))
  | Let_step : ∀ x v e,
    pure_step (Let x (Val v) e) (subst x v e)
  | LetUnit_step : ∀ e,
    pure_step (LetUnit (Val UnitV) e) e
  | LetProd_step : ∀ x1 x2 v1 v2 e,
    pure_step (LetProd x1 x2 (Val (PairV v1 v2)) e) (subst x1 v1 $ subst x2 v2 e)
  | Relabel_step : ∀ π1 π2 c p,
    pure_step (Relabel π1 (Val (ChanV (c,p) π2))) (Val (ChanV (c,p) (π2 ∘ π1))).

Definition entryT := (nat * val)%type.

Notation bufsT A B V := (gmap B (gmap A (list V))).

Definition heap := bufsT participant endpoint entryT.

Definition push `{Countable A, Countable B} {V} (p : A) (q : B) (x : V) (bufss : bufsT A B V) : bufsT A B V :=
  alter (alter (λ buf, buf ++ [x]) p) q bufss.

Definition pop `{Countable A, Countable B} {V} (p : A) (q : B) (bufss : bufsT A B V) : option (V * bufsT A B V) :=
  match bufss !! q with
  | Some bufs =>
    match bufs !! p with
    | Some (v :: buf) => Some (v, <[ q := <[ p := buf ]> bufs ]> bufss)
    | _ => None
    end
  | None => None
  end.

Definition init_chans {A} n : bufsT participant participant A :=
  fin_gmap n (λ i, fin_gmap n (λ j, [])).

Definition init_threads (c : session) (n : nat) (fv : fin n -> val) : list expr :=
  fin_list n (λ i, App (Val (fv i)) (Val (ChanV (c, S (fin_to_nat i)) id))).

Inductive head_step : expr -> heap -> expr -> heap -> list expr -> Prop :=
  | Pure_step : ∀ e e' h,
    pure_step e e' -> head_step e h e' h []
  | Send_step : ∀ h c p q y i π,


    head_step (Send q (Val (ChanV (c,p) π)) i (Val y)) h
          (Val (ChanV (c,p) π))
          (push p (c,π q) (i,y) h)
          []
  | Recv_step : ∀ h c p q i y h' π,
    pop (π p) (c,q) h = Some ((i,y), h') ->
    head_step (Recv p (Val (ChanV (c,q) π))) h
          (Val (InjNV i (PairV (ChanV (c,q) π) y)))
          h'
          []
  | Close_step : ∀ c p h π,
    head_step (Close (Val (ChanV (c,p) π))) h
          (Val UnitV)
          (delete (c,p) h)
          []
  | Spawn_step : ∀ (h : heap) c n f fv,
    (∀ p, h !! (c,p) = None) ->
    (∀ p, f p = Val (fv p)) ->
    head_step
      (Spawn n f) h
      (Val (ChanV (c, 0) id))
      (gmap_unslice (init_chans (S n)) c ∪ h)
      (init_threads c n fv).

Inductive ctx1 : (expr -> expr) -> Prop :=
  | Ctx_App_l e : ctx1 (λ x, App x e)
  | Ctx_App_r v : ctx1 (λ x, App (Val v) x)
  | Ctx_Pair_l e : ctx1 (λ x, Pair x e)
  | Ctx_Pair_r v : ctx1 (λ x, Pair (Val v) x)
  | Ctx_Inj b : ctx1 (λ x, Inj b x)
  | Ctx_UApp_l e : ctx1 (λ x, UApp x e)
  | Ctx_UApp_r v : ctx1 (λ x, UApp (Val v) x)
  | Ctx_Send_l p e i : ctx1 (λ x, Send p x i e)
  | Ctx_Send_r p v i : ctx1 (λ x, Send p (Val v) i x)
  | Ctx_Recv p : ctx1 (λ x, Recv p x)
  | Ctx_Let s e : ctx1 (λ x, Let s x e)
  | Ctx_LetUnit e : ctx1 (λ x, LetUnit x e)
  | Ctx_LetProd s1 s2 e : ctx1 (λ x, LetProd s1 s2 x e)
  | Ctx_MatchVoid : ctx1 (λ x, MatchVoid x)
  | Ctx_MatchSum s e1 e2 : ctx1 (λ x, MatchSum x s e1 e2)
  | Ctx_InjN i : ctx1 (λ x, InjN i x)
  | Ctx_MatchSumN n f : ctx1 (λ x, MatchSumN n x f)
  | Ctx_If e1 e2 : ctx1 (λ x, If x e1 e2)
  | Ctx_Spawn n (f : fin n -> expr) (p : fin n) :
    ctx1 (λ x, Spawn n (λ q, if decide (p = q) then x else f q))
  | Ctx_Close : ctx1 (λ x, Close x)
  | Ctx_Relabel π : ctx1 (λ x, Relabel π x).

Inductive ctx : (expr -> expr) -> Prop :=
  | Ctx_nil : ctx (λ x, x)
  | Ctx_cons : ∀ k1 k2, ctx1 k1 -> ctx k2 -> ctx (λ x, (k1 (k2 x))).

Inductive ctx_step : expr -> heap -> expr -> heap -> list expr -> Prop :=
  | Ctx_step : ∀ k e h e' h' ts,
    ctx k -> head_step e h e' h' ts -> ctx_step (k e) h (k e') h' ts.

Inductive stepi : nat -> list expr -> heap -> list expr -> heap -> Prop :=
  | Head_step : ∀ e e' h h' i ts es,
    ctx_step e h e' h' ts ->
    es !! i = Some e ->
    stepi i es h (<[i := e']> es ++ ts) h'.

Definition can_stepi i es h := ∃ es' h', stepi i es h es' h'.

Definition step es h es' h' := ∃ i, stepi i es h es' h'.

Inductive steps : list expr -> heap -> list expr -> heap -> Prop :=
  | Trans_step : ∀ e1 e2 e3 s1 s2 s3,
    step e1 s1 e2 s2 ->
    steps e2 s2 e3 s3 ->
    steps e1 s1 e3 s3
  | Empty_step : ∀ e1 s1,
    steps e1 s1 e1 s1.

CoInductive session_type' (T : Type) :=
  | SendT n : participant -> (fin n -> T) -> (fin n -> session_type' T) -> session_type' T
  | RecvT n : participant -> (fin n -> T) -> (fin n -> session_type' T) -> session_type' T
  | EndT : session_type' T.

Arguments SendT {_} _ _ _.

Arguments RecvT {_} _ _ _.

Arguments EndT {_}.

Global Instance finvec_equiv `{Equiv T} n : Equiv (fin n -> T) := λ f g, ∀ i, f i ≡ g i.

CoInductive session_type_equiv `{Equiv T} : Equiv (session_type' T) :=
  | cteq_EndT : EndT ≡ EndT
  | cteq_SendT n t1 t2 f1 f2 p : t1 ≡ t2 -> f1 ≡ f2 -> SendT n p t1 f1 ≡ SendT n p t2 f2
  | cteq_RecvT n t1 t2 f1 f2 p : t1 ≡ t2 -> f1 ≡ f2 -> RecvT n p t1 f1 ≡ RecvT n p t2 f2.

Global Existing Instance session_type_equiv.

Definition session_type_id {T} (s : session_type' T) : session_type' T :=
  match s with
  | SendT n p t s' => SendT n p t s'
  | RecvT n p t s' => RecvT n p t s'
  | EndT => EndT
  end.

CoInductive type :=
  | UnitT : type
  | VoidT : type
  | NatT : type
  | PairT : type -> type -> type
  | SumT : type -> type -> type
  | SumNT n : (fin n -> type) -> type
  | FunT : type -> type -> type
  | UFunT : type -> type -> type
  | ChanT : session_type' type -> type.

Definition type_id (t : type) :=
  match t with
  | UnitT => UnitT
  | VoidT => VoidT
  | NatT => NatT
  | PairT t1 t2 => PairT t1 t2
  | SumT t1 t2 => SumT t1 t2
  | SumNT n f => SumNT n f
  | FunT t1 t2 => FunT t1 t2
  | UFunT t1 t2 => UFunT t1 t2
  | ChanT s => ChanT s
  end.

CoInductive type_equiv : Equiv type :=
  | teq_UnitT : UnitT ≡ UnitT
  | teq_VoidT : VoidT ≡ VoidT
  | teq_NatT : NatT ≡ NatT
  | teq_PairT t1 t2 t1' t2' : t1 ≡ t2 -> t1' ≡ t2' -> PairT t1 t1' ≡ PairT t2 t2'
  | teq_SumT t1 t2 t1' t2' : t1 ≡ t2 -> t1' ≡ t2' -> SumT t1 t1' ≡ SumT t2 t2'
  | teq_SumNT n f1 f2 : f1 ≡ f2 -> SumNT n f1 ≡ SumNT n f2
  | teq_FunT t1 t2 t1' t2' : t1 ≡ t2 -> t1' ≡ t2' -> FunT t1 t1' ≡ FunT t2 t2'
  | teq_UFunT t1 t2 t1' t2' : t1 ≡ t2 -> t1' ≡ t2' -> UFunT t1 t1' ≡ UFunT t2 t2'
  | teq_ChanT s1 s2 : s1 ≡ s2 -> ChanT s1 ≡ ChanT s2.

Global Existing Instance type_equiv.

Notation session_type := (session_type' type).

CoFixpoint relabelT (π : participant -> participant) (σ : session_type) :=
  match σ with
  | SendT n p ts σs => SendT n (π p) ts (relabelT π ∘ σs)
  | RecvT n p ts σs => RecvT n (π p) ts (relabelT π ∘ σs)
  | EndT => EndT
  end.

Notation envT := (gmap string type).

CoInductive unrestricted : type -> Prop :=
  | Nat_unrestricted : unrestricted NatT
  | Unit_unrestricted : unrestricted UnitT
  | Void_unrestricted : unrestricted VoidT
  | UFun_unrestricted t1 t2 : unrestricted (UFunT t1 t2)
  | Pair_unrestricted t1 t2 :
    unrestricted t1 -> unrestricted t2 ->
    unrestricted (PairT t1 t2)
  | Sum_unrestricted t1 t2 :
    unrestricted t1 -> unrestricted t2 ->
    unrestricted (SumT t1 t2)
  | SumN_unrestricted n f :
    (∀ i, unrestricted (f i)) -> unrestricted (SumNT n f).

Definition disj (Γ1 Γ2 : envT) : Prop :=
  ∀ i t1 t2, Γ1 !! i = Some t1 -> Γ2 !! i = Some t2 -> t1 ≡ t2 ∧ unrestricted t1.

Definition Γunrestricted (Γ : envT) :=
  ∀ x t, Γ !! x = Some t -> unrestricted t.

Record disj_union n (Γ : envT) (fΓ : fin n -> envT) : Prop := {
  du_disj p q : p ≠ q -> disj (fΓ p) (fΓ q);
  du_left p x t : (fΓ p) !! x ≡ Some t -> Γ !! x ≡ Some t;
  du_right x t : Γ !! x ≡ Some t -> ∃ p, (fΓ p) !! x ≡ Some t
}.

Definition sentryT := (nat * type)%type.

Definition sbufsT := bufsT participant participant sentryT.

Definition can_progress {A}
  (bufs : bufsT participant participant A)
  (σs : gmap participant session_type) := ∃ q σ,
    σs !! q = Some σ ∧
    match σ with
    | RecvT n p _ _ => ∃ y bufs', pop p q bufs = Some(y,bufs')
    | _ => True
    end.

Definition buf_empty (bufs : bufsT participant participant sentryT) (p : participant) :=
  ∀ bs, bufs !! p = Some bs ->
    ∀ q buf, bs !! q = Some buf -> buf = [].

Definition bufs_empty {A} (bufs : bufsT participant participant A) :=
  ∀ p q, pop p q bufs = None.

Definition is_present `{Countable A, Countable B} {V}
    p q (bufss : bufsT A B V) :=
  match bufss !! q with
  | Some bufs => match bufs !! p with Some _ => True | None => False end
  | None => False
  end.

CoInductive sbufs_typed
  (bufs : bufsT participant participant sentryT)
  (σs : gmap participant session_type) : Prop := {




  sbufs_typed_send
      (n : nat) (p q : participant) ts ss (i : fin n) :
    σs !! p = Some (SendT n q ts ss) ->
      is_present p q bufs ∧
      sbufs_typed (push p q (fin_to_nat i,ts i) bufs) (<[p:=ss i]> σs);




  sbufs_typed_recv
      (bufs' : bufsT participant participant sentryT)
      (n : nat) (p q : participant) t i ts ss :
    σs !! q = Some (RecvT n p ts ss) ->
    pop p q bufs = Some((i,t),bufs') ->
    ∃ i', i = fin_to_nat i' ∧ t = ts i' ∧
      sbufs_typed bufs' (<[ q := ss i' ]> σs);




  sbufs_typed_end p :
    σs !! p = Some EndT ->
      buf_empty bufs p ∧
      sbufs_typed (delete p bufs) (delete p σs);


  sbufs_typed_progress :
    bufs = ∅ ∨ can_progress bufs σs;


  sbufs_typed_dom :
    dom bufs = dom σs
}.

Definition consistent n (σs : fin n -> session_type) :=
  sbufs_typed (init_chans n) (fin_gmap n σs).

Inductive typed : envT -> expr -> type -> Prop :=
  | Unit_typed Γ :
    Γunrestricted Γ ->
    typed Γ (Val UnitV) UnitT
  | Nat_typed : ∀ Γ n,
    Γunrestricted Γ ->
    typed Γ (Val (NatV n)) NatT
  | Var_typed : ∀ Γ x t t',
    Γ !! x = None ->
    Γunrestricted Γ ->
    t ≡ t' ->
    typed (Γ ∪ {[ x := t ]}) (Var x) t'
  | Pair_typed : ∀ Γ1 Γ2 e1 e2 t1 t2,
    disj Γ1 Γ2 ->
    typed Γ1 e1 t1 ->
    typed Γ2 e2 t2 ->
    typed (Γ1 ∪ Γ2) (Pair e1 e2) (PairT t1 t2)
  | App_typed : ∀ Γ1 Γ2 e1 e2 t1 t2,
    disj Γ1 Γ2 ->
    typed Γ1 e1 (FunT t1 t2) ->
    typed Γ2 e2 t1 ->
    typed (Γ1 ∪ Γ2) (App e1 e2) t2
  | UApp_typed : ∀ Γ1 Γ2 e1 e2 t1 t2,
    disj Γ1 Γ2 ->
    typed Γ1 e1 (UFunT t1 t2) ->
    typed Γ2 e2 t1 ->
    typed (Γ1 ∪ Γ2) (UApp e1 e2) t2
  | Lam_typed : ∀ Γ x e t1 t2,
    Γ !! x = None ->
    typed (Γ ∪ {[ x := t1 ]}) e t2 ->
    typed Γ (Lam x e) (FunT t1 t2)
  | ULam_typed : ∀ Γ x e t1 t2,
    Γ !! x = None ->
    Γunrestricted Γ ->
    typed (Γ ∪ {[ x := t1 ]}) e t2 ->
    typed Γ (ULam x e) (UFunT t1 t2)
  | Send_typed : ∀ Γ1 Γ2 e1 e2 n t r p i,
    disj Γ1 Γ2 ->
    typed Γ1 e1 (ChanT (SendT n p t r)) ->
    typed Γ2 e2 (t i) ->
    typed (Γ1 ∪ Γ2) (Send p e1 (fin_to_nat i) e2) (ChanT (r i))
  | Recv_typed : ∀ Γ e n t r p,
    typed Γ e (ChanT (RecvT n p t r)) ->
    typed Γ (Recv p e) (SumNT n (λ i, PairT (ChanT (r i)) (t i)))
  | Let_typed : ∀ Γ1 Γ2 e1 e2 t1 t2 x,
    disj Γ1 Γ2 ->
    Γ2 !! x = None ->
    typed Γ1 e1 t1 ->
    typed (Γ2 ∪ {[ x := t1 ]}) e2 t2 ->
    typed (Γ1 ∪ Γ2) (Let x e1 e2) t2
  | LetUnit_typed : ∀ Γ1 Γ2 e1 e2 t,
    disj Γ1 Γ2 ->
    typed Γ1 e1 UnitT ->
    typed Γ2 e2 t ->
    typed (Γ1 ∪ Γ2) (LetUnit e1 e2) t
  | LetProd_typed : ∀ Γ1 Γ2 e1 e2 t11 t12 t2 x1 x2,
    disj Γ1 Γ2 ->
    x1 ≠ x2 ->
    Γ2 !! x1 = None ->
    Γ2 !! x2 = None ->
    typed Γ1 e1 (PairT t11 t12) ->
    typed (Γ2 ∪ {[ x1 := t11 ]} ∪ {[ x2 := t12 ]}) e2 t2 ->
    typed (Γ1 ∪ Γ2) (LetProd x1 x2 e1 e2) t2
  | MatchVoid_typed : ∀ Γ e t,
    typed Γ e VoidT ->
    typed Γ (MatchVoid e) t
  | MatchSum_typed : ∀ Γ1 Γ2 e1 eL eR tL tR t x,
    disj Γ1 Γ2 ->
    Γ2 !! x = None ->
    typed Γ1 e1 (SumT tL tR) ->
    typed (Γ2 ∪ {[ x := tL ]}) eL t ->
    typed (Γ2 ∪ {[ x := tR ]}) eR t ->
    typed (Γ1 ∪ Γ2) (MatchSum e1 x eL eR) t
  | InjN_typed : ∀ Γ n f i e,
    typed Γ e (f i) ->
    typed Γ (InjN (fin_to_nat i) e) (SumNT n f)
  | MatchSumN_typed : ∀ n Γ1 Γ2 t (f : fin n -> type) fc e,
    disj Γ1 Γ2 ->
    (n = 0 -> Γ2 = ∅) ->
    typed Γ1 e (SumNT n f) ->
    (∀ i, typed Γ2 (fc i) (FunT (f i) t)) ->
    typed (Γ1 ∪ Γ2) (MatchSumN n e fc) t
  | If_typed : ∀ Γ1 Γ2 e1 e2 e3 t,
    disj Γ1 Γ2 ->
    typed Γ1 e1 NatT ->
    typed Γ2 e2 t ->
    typed Γ2 e3 t ->
    typed (Γ1 ∪ Γ2) (If e1 e2 e3) t
  | Spawn_typed : ∀ n Γ (fΓ : fin n -> envT) (f : fin n -> expr) (σs : fin (S n) -> session_type),
    consistent (S n) σs ->
    disj_union n Γ fΓ ->
    (∀ p, typed (fΓ p) (f p) (FunT (ChanT (σs (FS p))) UnitT)) ->
    typed Γ (Spawn n f) (ChanT (σs 0%fin))
  | Close_typed : ∀ Γ e,
    typed Γ e (ChanT EndT) ->
    typed Γ (Close e) UnitT
  | Relabel_typed : ∀ Γ π e σ,
    typed Γ e (ChanT (relabelT π σ)) ->
    typed Γ (Relabel π e) (ChanT σ)
  | Iso_typed : ∀ Γ t t' e,
    t ≡ t' ->
    typed Γ e t ->
    typed Γ e t'.

From stdpp Require Import gmap.

From stdpp Require Export finite.

Fixpoint insert2 {T} (i : nat) (x : T) (xs : list T) : list T :=
  match i,xs with
  | 0,xs => x :: xs
  | S i',y :: xs => y :: insert2 i' x xs
  | S i',[] => [x]
  end.

Section disjoint.

Context `{Countable K}.

Context {V : Type}.

Definition disjoint (xs : list (gmap K V)) :=
    forall i j h1 h2,
        xs !! i = Some h1 -> xs !! j = Some h2 -> i ≠ j -> h1 ##ₘ h2.

End disjoint.

Definition fin_list {A} n (f : fin n -> A) : list A := vec_to_list (fun_to_vec f).

Definition fin_gset `{Countable A} n (f : fin n -> A) : gset A
  := list_to_set (fin_list n f).

Definition all_fin n := fin_gset n id.

Definition big_union `{Countable A} : gset (gset A) -> gset A := set_fold (∪) ∅.

Definition fin_union `{Countable A} n (f : fin n -> gset A) : gset A :=
  big_union (fin_gset n f).

Fixpoint list_to_mapi' {A} (xs : list A) (n : nat) : gmap nat A :=
  match xs with
  | [] => ∅
  | x::r => <[ n := x ]> (list_to_mapi' r (S n))
  end.

Definition list_to_mapi {A} (xs : list A) := list_to_mapi' xs 0.

Definition fin_gmap {T} n : (fin n -> T) -> gmap nat T := list_to_mapi ∘ fin_list n.

Definition gmap_slice `{Countable K1, Countable K2} {A} (m : gmap (K1 * K2) A) (x : K1) : gmap K2 A :=
  default ∅ (map_curry (M1:=gmap K1) (M2:=gmap K2) m !! x).

Definition map_kmap `{∀ A, Insert K2 A (M2 A), ∀ A, Empty (M2 A),
    ∀ A, MapFold K1 A (M1 A)} {A} (f : K1 → K2) (m : M1 A) : M2 A :=
  list_to_map (fmap (prod_map f id) (map_to_list m)).

Definition gmap_unslice `{Countable K1, Countable K2} {A} (m : gmap K2 A) (x : K1) : gmap (K1 * K2) A :=
  map_kmap (λ y, (x,y)) m.

From cgraphs.multiparty Require Import definitions.
From cgraphs.multiparty Require Import langdef.
From stdpp Require Import gmap finite.

(* Resource functions: set of endpoints occurring as channel literals *)
Fixpoint res_expr (e : expr) : gset endpoint :=
  match e with
  | Val v => res_val v
  | Var _ => ∅
  | Pair e1 e2 | App e1 e2 | UApp e1 e2 | Send _ e1 _ e2
  | Let _ e1 e2 | LetUnit e1 e2 | LetProd _ _ e1 e2 | If e1 e2 e3
      => res_expr e1 ∪ res_expr e2 ∪ (match e with If _ _ e3 => res_expr e3 | _ => ∅ end)
  | Inj _ e1 | InjN _ e1 | Recv _ e1 | Lam _ e1 | ULam _ e1
  | MatchVoid e1 | Close e1 | Relabel _ e1 => res_expr e1
  | MatchSum e1 _ e2 e3 => res_expr e1 ∪ res_expr e2 ∪ res_expr e3
  | MatchSumN n e f => res_expr e ∪ fin_union n (fun i => res_expr (f i))
  | Spawn n f => fin_union n (fun i => res_expr (f i))
  end
with res_val (v : val) : gset endpoint :=
  match v with
  | UnitV | NatV _ => ∅
  | PairV v1 v2 => res_val v1 ∪ res_val v2
  | InjV _ v | InjNV _ v => res_val v
  | FunV _ e | UFunV _ e => res_expr e
  | ChanV e _ => {[ e ]}
  end.

Eval compute in res_expr (Pair (Val UnitV) (Close (Val (ChanV (3,4) id)))).
Eval compute in res_val (ChanV (3,4) id).

(* Check deadlock is inhabited concretely by computing the relevant lookups *)
Definition es_dl : list expr := [Recv 0 (Val (ChanV (0,0) id))].
Definition h_dl : heap := {[ (0,0) := {[ 0 := [] ]} ]}.

Eval compute in (es_dl !! 0).
Eval compute in (h_dl !! (0,0)).
Eval compute in (pop id (0,0) h_dl).
Eval compute in (pop id (0,0) h_dl).
Eval compute in (res_expr (Recv 0 (Val (ChanV (0,0) id)))).
Eval compute in (gmap_slice h_dl 0).
Eval compute in (expr_refs (Recv 0 (Val (ChanV (0,0) id)))).
EOF

From cgraphs.multiparty Require Import definitions.

Lemma reachable_not_in_deadlock es h :
  ∀ x, reachable es h x -> ∀ s, deadlock es h s -> x ∈ s -> False.
Proof.
  intros x Hr. induction Hr.
  - intros s Hdl Hx. exact (dl_threadb es h s Hdl i Hx H).
  - intros s Hdl Hx. apply (IHHr s Hdl). exact (dl_threadw es h s Hdl i c Hx H).
  - intros s Hdl Hx. apply (IHHr s Hdl). exact (dl_chan es h s Hdl c x Hx H).
Qed.

Lemma fully_reachable_deadlock_free es h :
  fully_reachable es h -> deadlock_free es h.
Proof.
  intros Hfr s Hdl.
  destruct (set_choose s) as [y Hy].
  - intros H0. exact (dl_nonempty es h s Hdl H0).
  - exact (reachable_not_in_deadlock es h y (Hfr y (dl_active es h s Hdl y Hy)) s Hdl Hy).
Qed.

From cgraphs.multiparty Require Import definitions.

From cgraphs.multiparty Require Import langdef.

From stdpp Require Import gmap finite.

(** * Auxiliary lemmas about the communication graph *)

(* The two notions [deadlock_free] and [fully_reachable] are dual.  The
   direction below is the elementary one and is used to reduce the main
   theorem to full reachability. *)

Lemma reachable_not_in_deadlock es h :
  forall x, reachable es h x -> forall s, deadlock es h s -> x ∈ s -> False.
Proof.
  intros x Hr. induction Hr.
  - intros s Hdl Hx. exact (dl_threadb es h s Hdl i Hx H).
  - intros s Hdl Hx. apply (IHHr s Hdl). exact (dl_threadw es h s Hdl i c Hx H).
  - intros s Hdl Hx. apply (IHHr s Hdl). exact (dl_chan es h s Hdl c x Hx H).
Qed.

Lemma fully_reachable_deadlock_free es h :
  fully_reachable es h -> deadlock_free es h.
Proof.
  intros Hfr s Hdl.
  destruct (set_choose_or_empty s) as [[y Hy] | Heq].
  - exact (reachable_not_in_deadlock es h y (Hfr y (dl_active es h s Hdl y Hy)) s Hdl Hy).
  - exfalso. apply (dl_nonempty es h s Hdl).
    apply set_eq. intros z. exact (proj1 (set_equiv s ∅) Heq z).
Qed.

(** * Main theorem *)

Theorem deadlock_freedom_and_full_reachability e es h :
  typed ∅ e UnitT -> steps [e] ∅ es h ->
  deadlock_free es h ∧ fully_reachable es h.
Proof.
  intros Hty Hst.
  split.
  - apply fully_reachable_deadlock_free.
Abort.

From cgraphs.multiparty Require Import definitions.

From cgraphs.multiparty Require Import langdef.

From stdpp Require Import gmap finite.

(** * Auxiliary lemmas about the communication graph *)

(* [deadlock_free] and [fully_reachable] are dual notions.  The direction
   below is elementary; it shows that the second conjunct of the main
   theorem is implied by the first one. *)

Lemma reachable_not_in_deadlock es h :
  forall x, reachable es h x -> forall s, deadlock es h s -> x ∈ s -> False.
Proof.
  intros x Hr. induction Hr.
  - intros s Hdl Hx. exact (dl_threadb es h s Hdl i Hx H).
  - intros s Hdl Hx. apply (IHHr s Hdl). exact (dl_threadw es h s Hdl i c Hx H).
  - intros s Hdl Hx. apply (IHHr s Hdl). exact (dl_chan es h s Hdl c x Hx H).
Qed.

Lemma fully_reachable_deadlock_free es h :
  fully_reachable es h -> deadlock_free es h.
Proof.
  intros Hfr s Hdl.
  destruct (set_choose_or_empty s) as [[y Hy] | Heq].
  - exact (reachable_not_in_deadlock es h y (Hfr y (dl_active es h s Hdl y Hy)) s Hdl Hy).
  - exfalso. apply (dl_nonempty es h s Hdl).
    apply set_eq. intros z. exact (proj1 (set_equiv s ∅) Heq z).
Qed.

(** * Main theorem *)

Theorem deadlock_freedom_and_full_reachability e es h :
  typed ∅ e UnitT -> steps [e] ∅ es h ->
  deadlock_free es h ∧ fully_reachable es h.

Lemma map_union_ne_empty {K A V} `{Countable K, Countable A}

From stdpp Require Import gmap finite.
From cgraphs.multiparty Require Import definitions.
From cgraphs.multiparty Require Import langdef.

Lemma map_union_ne_empty {K A V} `{Countable K, Countable A}
  (f : V -> gset A) (m : gmap K V) : map_union f m ≠ ∅ -> m ≠ ∅.
Proof. intros Hne Hm. apply Hne. subst m. reflexivity. Qed.

Lemma gmap_nonempty_lookup {K V} `{Countable K} (m : gmap K V) :
  m ≠ ∅ -> ∃ k v, m !! k = Some v.
Proof.
  intros Hm.
  assert (Hne : map_to_list m ≠ []).
  { intro Hnil. apply Hm. apply map_to_list_empty_iff. exact Hnil. }
  destruct (map_to_list m) as [| (k,v) l] eqn:E; [done|].
  exists k, v. apply elem_of_map_to_list. rewrite E. left.
Qed.

Lemma gmap_slice_lookup (h : heap) (c : session) (p : participant)
  (inner : gmap participant (list entryT)) :
  gmap_slice h c !! p = Some inner -> h !! (c,p) = Some inner.
Proof.
  intros H. unfold gmap_slice in H.
  set (mc := map_curry (M1:=gmap session) (M2:=gmap participant) (M12:=gmap (session*participant))
       (K1:=session) (K2:=participant) h) in *.
  destruct (mc !! c) as [m|] eqn:Em; [|simpl in H; discriminate H].
  simpl in H.
  assert (Hunc : map_uncurry (M1:=gmap session) (M2:=gmap participant) (M12:=gmap (session*participant))
       (K1:=session) (K2:=participant) mc = h).
  { subst mc. apply map_uncurry_curry. }
  rewrite <- Hunc.
  change (map_uncurry (M1:=gmap session) (M2:=gmap participant) (M12:=gmap (session*participant))
       (K1:=session) (K2:=participant) mc !! (c,p) = Some inner).
  rewrite (lookup_map_uncurry (M1:=gmap session) (M2:=gmap participant) (MC:=gmap (session*participant))
       (K1:=session) (K2:=participant) mc c p).
  rewrite Em. simpl. exact H.
Qed.

Lemma active_of_refs es h x :
  (∃ c, Chan c ∈ obj_refs es h x) -> active es h x.
Proof.
  intros [c Hc]. destruct x as [n|s].
  - simpl in Hc. destruct (es !! n) as [e|] eqn:E; [|simpl in Hc; rewrite elem_of_empty in Hc; done].
    exists e. split; [done|]. intro He. subst e. simpl in Hc.
    rewrite elem_of_empty in Hc. done.

    assert (Hne : gmap_slice h s ≠ ∅).
    { intro Hs. apply Hc. rewrite Hs. reflexivity. }
    destruct (gmap_nonempty_lookup (gmap_slice h s) Hne) as (p & inner & Hp).
    exists p. rewrite (gmap_slice_lookup h s p inner Hp). simpl. done.
Qed.
EOF

From cgraphs.multiparty Require Import definitions.

From cgraphs.multiparty Require Import langdef.

(** * Auxiliary lemmas about the communication graph *)

(** [deadlock_free] and [fully_reachable] are dual notions.  The direction
    below is elementary and lets us reduce the main theorem to full
    reachability. *)

Lemma reachable_not_in_deadlock es h :
  forall x, reachable es h x -> forall s, deadlock es h s -> x ∈ s -> False.
Proof.
  intros x Hr. induction Hr.
  - intros s Hdl Hx. exact (dl_threadb es h s Hdl i Hx H).
  - intros s Hdl Hx. apply (IHHr s Hdl). exact (dl_threadw es h s Hdl i c Hx H).
  - intros s Hdl Hx. apply (IHHr s Hdl). exact (dl_chan es h s Hdl c x Hx H).
Qed.

Lemma fully_reachable_deadlock_free es h :
  fully_reachable es h -> deadlock_free es h.
Proof.
  intros Hfr s Hdl.
  destruct (set_choose_or_empty s) as [[y Hy] | Heq].
  - exact (reachable_not_in_deadlock es h y (Hfr y (dl_active es h s Hdl y Hy)) s Hdl Hy).
  - exfalso. apply (dl_nonempty es h s Hdl).
    apply set_eq. intros z. exact (proj1 (set_equiv s ∅) Heq z).
Qed.

(** * Basic facts about the heap representation *)

Lemma map_union_ne_empty {K A V} `{Countable K, Countable A}
  (f : V -> gset A) (m : gmap K V) : map_union f m ≠ ∅ -> m ≠ ∅.
Proof. intros Hne Hm. apply Hne. subst m. reflexivity. Qed.

Lemma gmap_nonempty_lookup {K V} `{Countable K} (m : gmap K V) :
  m ≠ ∅ -> ∃ k v, m !! k = Some v.
Proof.
  intros Hm.
  assert (Hne : map_to_list m ≠ []).
  { intro Hnil. apply Hm. apply map_to_list_empty_iff. exact Hnil. }
  destruct (map_to_list m) as [| (k,v) l] eqn:E; [done|].
  exists k, v. apply elem_of_map_to_list. rewrite E. left.
Qed.

Lemma bufs_refs_empty : bufs_refs (∅ : bufsT participant participant entryT) = ∅.
Proof. reflexivity. Qed.

Lemma gmap_slice_lookup (h : heap) (c : session) (p : participant)
  (inner : gmap participant (list entryT)) :
  gmap_slice h c !! p = Some inner -> h !! (c,p) = Some inner.
Proof.
  intros H. unfold gmap_slice in H.
  set (mc := map_curry (M1:=gmap session) (M2:=gmap participant) (M12:=gmap (session*participant))
       (K1:=session) (K2:=participant) h) in *.
  destruct (mc !! c) as [m|] eqn:Em; [|simpl in H; discriminate H].
  simpl in H.
  assert (Hunc : map_uncurry (M1:=gmap session) (M2:=gmap participant) (M12:=gmap (session*participant))
       (K1:=session) (K2:=participant) mc = h).
  { subst mc. apply map_uncurry_curry. }
  rewrite <- Hunc.
  change (map_uncurry (M1:=gmap session) (M2:=gmap participant) (M12:=gmap (session*participant))
       (K1:=session) (K2:=participant) mc !! (c,p) = Some inner).
  rewrite (lookup_map_uncurry (M1:=gmap session) (M2:=gmap participant) (MC:=gmap (session*participant))
       (K1:=session) (K2:=participant) mc c p).
  rewrite Em. simpl. exact H.
Qed.

(** Any object that references a channel is active.  This is used when the
    complement of the reachable objects is shown to be a deadlock. *)

Lemma active_of_refs es h x :
  (∃ c, Chan c ∈ obj_refs es h x) -> active es h x.
Proof.
  intros [c Hc]. destruct x as [n|s].
  - simpl in Hc. destruct (es !! n) as [e|] eqn:E; [|simpl in Hc; rewrite elem_of_empty in Hc; done].
    exists e. split; [done|]. intro He. subst e. simpl in Hc.
    rewrite elem_of_empty in Hc. done.
  - simpl in Hc.
    assert (Hne : gmap_slice h s ≠ ∅).
    { intro Hs. rewrite Hs, bufs_refs_empty, elem_of_empty in Hc. done. }
    destruct (gmap_nonempty_lookup (gmap_slice h s) Hne) as (p & inner & Hp).
    exists p. rewrite (gmap_slice_lookup h s p inner Hp). simpl. done.
Qed.

(** * Main theorem *)

Theorem deadlock_freedom_and_full_reachability e es h :
  typed ∅ e UnitT -> steps [e] ∅ es h ->
  deadlock_free es h ∧ fully_reachable es h.

  | Pure_step : ∀ e e' h,

  | Send_step : ∀ h c p q y i π,


    head_step (Send q (Val (ChanV (c,p) π)) i (Val y)) h
          (Val (ChanV (c,p) π))

Inductive head_step : expr -> heap -> expr -> heap -> list expr -> Prop :=
  | Pure_step : ∀ e e' h,
    pure_step e e' -> head_step e h e' h []
  | Send_step : ∀ h c p q y i π,


    head_step (Send q (Val (ChanV (c,p) π)) i (Val y)) h

  | Recv_step : ∀ h c p q i y h' π,

    (∀ p, h !! (c,p) = None) ->
    (∀ p, f p = Val (fv p)) ->
    head_step

  | Ctx_App_l e : ctx1 (λ x, App x e)

  | Ctx_Send_r p v i : ctx1 (λ x, Send p (Val v) i x)
  | Ctx_Recv p : ctx1 (λ x, Recv p x)
  | Ctx_Let s e : ctx1 (λ x, Let s x e)
  | Ctx_LetUnit e : ctx1 (λ x, LetUnit x e)
  | Ctx_LetProd s1 s2 e : ctx1 (λ x, LetProd s1 s2 x e)

Arguments RecvT {_} _ _ _.

Global Instance finvec_equiv `{Equiv T} n : Equiv (fin n -> T) := λ f g, ∀ i, f i ≡ g i.

Notation session_type := (session_type' type).

CoFixpoint relabelT (π : participant -> participant) (σ : session_type) :=
  match σ with

  ∀ i t1 t2, Γ1 !! i = Some t1 -> Γ2 !! i = Some t2 -> t1 ≡ t2 ∧ unrestricted t1.

| Var x' => if decide (x = x') then Val a else e
  | App e1 e2 => App (subst x a e1) (subst x a e2)
  | Inj b e1 => Inj b (subst x a e1)
  | Pair e1 e2 => Pair (subst x a e1) (subst x a e2)
  | UApp e1 e2 => UApp (subst x a e1) (subst x a e2)
  | Lam x' e1 => if decide (x = x') then e else Lam x' (subst x a e1)
  | ULam x' e1 => if decide (x = x') then e else ULam x' (subst x a e1)
  | Send p e1 i e2 => Send p (subst x a e1) i (subst x a e2)
  | Recv p e1 => Recv p (subst x a e1)
  | Let x' e1 e2 => Let x' (subst x a e1) (if decide (x = x') then e2 else subst x a e2)
  | LetUnit e1 e2 => LetUnit (subst x a e1) (subst x a e2)
  | LetProd x' y' e1 e2 =>
    LetProd x' y' (subst x a e1) (if decide (x = x' ∨ x = y') then e2 else subst x a e2)
  | MatchVoid e1 => MatchVoid (subst x a e1)
  | MatchSum e1 x' eL eR =>

  | InjN n e => InjN n (subst x a e)
  | MatchSumN n e f => MatchSumN n (subst x a e) (λ i, subst x a (f i))

  | Close e1 => Close (subst x a e1)
  | Relabel π e1 => Relabel π (subst x a e1)

Inductive pure_step : expr -> expr -> Prop :=
  | Pair_step : ∀ v1 v2,
    pure_step (Pair (Val v1) (Val v2)) (Val (PairV v1 v2))
  | Inj_step : ∀ v1 b,
    pure_step (Inj b (Val v1)) (Val (InjV b v1))
  | App_step : ∀ x e a,
    pure_step (App (Val (FunV x e)) (Val a)) (subst x a e)
  | UApp_step : ∀ x e a,
    pure_step (UApp (Val (UFunV x e)) (Val a)) (subst x a e)
  | Lam_step : ∀ x e,
    pure_step (Lam x e) (Val (FunV x e))
  | ULam_step : ∀ x e,
    pure_step (ULam x e) (Val (UFunV x e))
  | If_step1 : ∀ n e1 e2,
    n ≠ 0 ->
    pure_step (If (Val (NatV n)) e1 e2) e1
  | If_step2 : ∀ e1 e2,
    pure_step (If (Val (NatV 0)) e1 e2) e2
  | MatchSum_step : ∀ x v eL eR b,
    pure_step (MatchSum (Val (InjV b v)) x eL eR)
      (if b then subst x v eL else subst x v eR)
  | InjN_step : ∀ n v,
    pure_step (InjN n (Val v)) (Val (InjNV n v))
  | MatchSumN_step : ∀ n i v f,
    pure_step (MatchSumN n (Val (InjNV (fin_to_nat i) v)) f) (App (f i) (Val v))
  | Let_step : ∀ x v e,
    pure_step (Let x (Val v) e) (subst x v e)
  | LetUnit_step : ∀ e,
    pure_step (LetUnit (Val UnitV) e) e
  | LetProd_step : ∀ x1 x2 v1 v2 e,
    pure_step (LetProd x1 x2 (Val (PairV v1 v2)) e) (subst x1 v1 $ subst x2 v2 e)
  | Relabel_step : ∀ π1 π2 c p,
    pure_step (Relabel π1 (Val (ChanV (c,p) π2))) (Val (ChanV (c,p) (π2 ∘ π1))).

Notation fin_rect2 := Fin.rect2

Fin.rect2 =
λ (P : ∀ n : nat, fin n → fin n → Type) (H0 : ∀ n : nat, P (S n) 0%fin 0%fin) 
  (H1 : ∀ (n : nat) (f : fin n), P (S n) 0%fin (FS f)) 
  (H2 : ∀ (n : nat) (f : fin n), P (S n) (FS f) 0%fin) 
  (HS : ∀ (n : nat) (f g : fin n), P n f g → P (S n) (FS f) (FS g)),
  fix rect2_fix (n : nat) (a : fin n) {struct a} : ∀ b : fin n, P n a b :=
    match a as a0 in (fin n0) return (∀ b : fin n0, P n0 a0 b) with
    | @Fin.F1 m =>
        λ b : fin (S m), Fin.caseS' b (P (S m) 0%fin) (H0 m) (H1 m)
    | @Fin.FS m a' =>
        λ b : fin (S m),
          Fin.caseS' b (λ b0 : fin (S m), P (S m) (FS a') b0) 
            (H2 m a') (λ b' : fin m, HS m a' b' (rect2_fix m a' b'))
    end
     : ∀ P : ∀ n : nat, fin n → fin n → Type,
         (∀ n : nat, P (S n) 0%fin 0%fin)
         → (∀ (n : nat) (f : fin n), P (S n) 0%fin (FS f))
           → (∀ (n : nat) (f : fin n), P (S n) (FS f) 0%fin)
             → (∀ (n : nat) (f g : fin n), P n f g → P (S n) (FS f) (FS g))
               → ∀ {n : nat} (a b : fin n), P n a b

Arguments Fin.rect2 (P H0 H1 H2 HS)%_function_scope 
  {n}%_nat_scope (a b)%_fin_scope
fin_dec_subproof = λ n0 : nat, eq_refl
     : ∀ n0 : nat, 0%fin = 0%fin

Arguments fin_dec_subproof n0%_nat_scope
fin_dec_subproof0 =
λ (n0 : nat) (t : fin n0),
  λ H : 0%fin = FS t,
    let H0 : False :=
      eq_ind 0%fin
        (λ e : fin (S n0), match e with
                           | Fin.F1 => True
                           | FS _ => False
                           end)
        I (FS t) H
      in
    False_ind False H0
  :
  0%fin ≠ FS t
     : ∀ (n0 : nat) (t : fin n0), 0%fin ≠ FS t

Arguments fin_dec_subproof0 n0%_nat_scope t%_fin_scope _
fin_dec_subproof1 =
λ (n0 : nat) (t : fin n0),
  λ H : FS t = 0%fin,
    let H0 : False :=
      eq_ind (FS t)
        (λ e : fin (S n0), match e with
                           | Fin.F1 => False
                           | FS _ => True
                           end)
        I 0%fin H
      in
    False_ind False H0
  :
  FS t ≠ 0%fin
     : ∀ (n0 : nat) (t : fin n0), FS t ≠ 0%fin

Arguments fin_dec_subproof1 n0%_nat_scope t%_fin_scope _
fin_dec_subproof2 =
λ (n0 : nat) (t t0 : fin n0) (e : t = t0), f_equal_help FS FS t t0 eq_refl e



(** [deadlock_free] and [fully_reachable] are dual notions.  The direction

Lemma reachable_not_in_deadlock es h :
  forall x, reachable es h x -> forall s, deadlock es h s -> x ∈ s -> False.
Proof.
  intros x Hr. induction Hr.
  - intros s Hdl Hx. exact (dl_threadb es h s Hdl i Hx H).
  - intros s Hdl Hx. apply (IHHr s Hdl). exact (dl_threadw es h s Hdl i c Hx H).
  - intros s Hdl Hx. apply (IHHr s Hdl). exact (dl_chan es h s Hdl c x Hx H).
Qed.

Lemma fully_reachable_deadlock_free es h :
  fully_reachable es h -> deadlock_free es h.
Proof.
  intros Hfr s Hdl.
  destruct (set_choose_or_empty s) as [[y Hy] | Heq].
  - exact (reachable_not_in_deadlock es h y (Hfr y (dl_active es h s Hdl y Hy)) s Hdl Hy).

    rejects the required conversion ("Not convertible").  Consequently

    [FunctionalExtensionality] the equality and the step become
    derivable, but that is an axiom not present in the supplied imports,

(** * Functions on finite domains *)

(** Main result : for functions [f:A->A] with finite [A],
    f injective <-> f bijective <-> f surjective. *)

#[local] Set Warnings "-stdlib-vector".
From Stdlib Require Import List PeanoNat Compare_dec EqNat Decidable ListDec.
From Stdlib Require Fin.
Set Implicit Arguments.

(** General definitions *)

Definition Injective {A B} (f : A->B) :=
 forall x y, f x = f y -> x = y.

Definition Surjective {A B} (f : A->B) :=
 forall y, exists x, f x = y.

Definition Bijective {A B} (f : A->B) :=
 exists g:B->A, (forall x, g (f x) = x) /\ (forall y, f (g y) = y).

(** Finiteness is defined here via exhaustive list enumeration *)

Definition Full {A:Type} (l:list A) := forall a:A, In a l.
Definition Finite (A:Type) := exists (l:list A), Full l.

(** In many of the following proofs, it will be convenient to have
    list enumerations without duplicates. As soon as we have
    decidability of equality (in Prop), this is equivalent
    to the previous notion (s. lemma Finite_dec). *)

Definition Listing {A:Type} (l:list A) := NoDup l /\ Full l.
Definition Finite' (A:Type) := exists (l:list A), Listing l.

Lemma Listing_decidable_eq {A:Type} (l:list A): Listing l -> decidable_eq A.
